import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# 1. Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Handle potential missing text values gracefully
train_df["text"] = train_df["text"].fillna("")
test_df["text"] = test_df["text"].fillna("")

# Map authors to numeric labels for model compatibility
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
y_train = train_df["author"].map(author_map).astype(int)

# 2. Strict hold-out validation split (stratified by author)
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"], y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# 3. Feature Extraction: Hybrid Word + Character TF-IDF
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=50000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=False,
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_train_word = word_vec.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_word = word_vec.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_word = word_vec.transform(test_df["text"])

char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=40000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    lowercase=False,
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_train_char = char_vec.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_char = char_vec.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_char = char_vec.transform(test_df["text"])

# Concatenate feature matrices
X_train_feat = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_feat = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_feat = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# 4. Model Training: Upgrade to LightGBM for non-linear interactions
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    max_depth=6,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)
model.fit(X_train_feat, y_train_split)

# 5. Validation Metric Computation
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_feat)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val.values, val_probs, labels=[0, 1, 2])
print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# 6. Test Prediction & Submission
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_feat)
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission[classes] = test_probs
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
